projects.title: Smart Library Analytics Platform
projects.subTitle: Operational analytics and predictive insights
projects.overview: An AI-powered analytics dashboard built with live operational data to support overdue prediction, reader segmentation, and department-level overdue-risk analysis.
projects.methodology: Data → SQL Server → Data Processing → Feature Engineering → ML Models → Prediction / Output Tables → .NET API → React Dashboard
projects.results: The system surfaces overdue predictions, reader segments, and department overdue-risk outputs in an operational dashboard. The supplied project information does not include measured model scores.

caseStudy.Problem: Library overdue patterns and department-level risk need to be surfaced from operational data.
caseStudy.Approach: Data processing and feature engineering feed machine-learning models and prediction/output tables.
caseStudy.Machine learning: Overdue prediction, reader clustering or segmentation, and department overdue-risk analysis.
caseStudy.Architecture: Data → SQL Server → Processing → Feature Engineering → ML Models → Output Tables → .NET API → React Dashboard
caseStudy.Evidence: The supplied project information describes the pipeline and outputs, but does not include public repository, demo, screenshots, or model scores.

projects.title: Road Traffic Accident Severity Prediction
projects.subTitle: Predictive Modeling & Classical ML Pipeline
projects.overview: Developed a predictive model to classify traffic accident severity (fatal, severe, minor) from road safety datasets.
projects.methodology: Engineered features from vehicle, weather, and temporal data on 100K+ records. Used XGBoost and LightGBM with SMOTE to resolve extreme class imbalances.
projects.results: A research manuscript based on this project was accepted for publication at ASCIS 2025.

projects.title: Electricity Load Forecasting System
projects.subTitle: Deep Learning / LSTM Time-Series System
projects.overview: Created a deep learning-based energy forecasting system to predict grid demand.
projects.methodology: Architected an LSTM-based forecasting model with temporal feature extraction, lag features, and seasonal decomposition.
projects.results: Designed to provide demand forecasts across multiple time horizons and support peak-load planning.

projects.title: Data Science Club Platform
projects.subTitle: Full-Stack Portal with RBAC Admin Dashboard
projects.overview: Built a collaboration portal for university data science students and club members.
projects.methodology: Engineered a scalable RESTful API with Node.js/Express, implemented role-based access control, JWT session handling, and MongoDB collections.
projects.results: The portal supports role-based access, event registration, and sharing project resources.

projects.title: Machine Learning Codes Repository
projects.subTitle: Curated Educational Algorithms & Workflows
projects.overview: Curated an open-source library showcasing foundational machine learning algorithms implemented from scratch.
projects.methodology: Built clean notebooks covering preprocessing, EDA, regression, classification, and validation.
projects.results: Includes notebooks for preprocessing, exploratory analysis, regression, classification, and model validation.

projects.title: Crop Prediction
projects.subTitle: Agricultural Yield Optimization & Recommendation System
projects.overview: Created an AI-driven agricultural planning platform to predict crop yield and suggest ideal crops based on soil and weather parameters.
projects.methodology: Trained predictive models on multi-regional soil chemistry and climatological datasets. Integrated an interactive Flask frontend with model inference.
projects.results: The application predicts crop yield and recommends crops from soil and weather inputs.
